title: Re-resolve linkage when resuming a woken run
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Persistent goals live in the client orchestrator. When a goal wakes, MechaHarness must re-resolve linkage and resume only if the checkpoint fingerprint still matches. Accepts the library half of inspiration requirement 17[^insp-r17]. Wake re-resolve for Dots MH-DOTS-02; effect-dispatch revalidation: `fangore_insp_effect_revalidation`[^insp-dots-02-wake].
implementation:
`GraphExecutor` wake resolve + resume. `CliInstrumentor` verb `wake_reresolve_resume`.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
